# Sandbox Group (sandbox.ceo)

> Hong Kong compliance, licensing and corporate services provider. Company listed on the website: Tech Boss Limited (TCSP licence TC011116). Services include Money Service Operator (MSO) licence applications and renewals with Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department, AML/CFT compliance, other licensing support, company secretarial and corporate services. Pages are available in Traditional Chinese (default), English (/en) and Simplified Chinese (/zh-Hans).

## MSO licensing
- [MSO licensing overview](https://www.sandbox.ceo/mso): services, requirements and FAQs for Hong Kong money service operators
- [MSO new licence application](https://www.sandbox.ceo/mso/new-application): process, documents and current government fees (effective 15 May 2026)
- [MSO licence renewal](https://www.sandbox.ceo/mso/renewal): 2-year validity, 45-day renewal deadline, renewal fees
